meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 重新执行你已安装的各项技能的安装步骤,从上游拉取最新代码覆盖旧副本,再运行构建和测试验证。只更新技能自身文件,不会动你的凭据、配置和数据。若容器内代码有变,会重建镜像。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 /update-skills 命令时触发。它先确认工作树干净且上游仓库正确,若有未提交改动会暂停,让你先提交或暂存。之后列出已安装的技能供你选择要重新应用哪些。

say.text: 更新我装好的所有技能
say.note: 先检查工作区,再让你挑选要更新的技能

say.text: 把 Slack 和 Discord 这两个技能更新到最新
say.note: 只重新应用你点名的技能
调用该技能更新已安装的技能

howto.what_en: Re-runs each installed skill's own apply step, pulling latest code from upstream over the old copy, then builds and tests. Only that skill's files change; credentials and config stay untouched. Rebuilds the image if container code changed.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /update-skills in Claude Code. Checks for a clean working tree and valid remote, stops if dirty, then lists installed skills and asks which to re-apply.

say_en.note: Checks the workspace, then asks you to pick which to update.

say_en.text: Update the Slack and Discord skills to the latest
say_en.note: Re-applies only the skills you named.
Invokes the skill to update installed skills.
